articles.title: The Quantum Puzzle Piece That Was Missing for 25 Years Has Finally Been Found
articles.summary: Quantum entanglement is like a secret handshake between particles. For decades, scientists could easily read one type of handshake (GHZ) but not another (W). Now, a team has built a device that reads W states in a single shot, unlocking new possibilities for teleportation and quantum computing.

articles.title: Was Halley's Comet Actually Discovered by an 11th-Century Monk?
articles.summary: Edmond Halley gets credit for recognizing that the comet now bearing his name returns every 76 years. But new research suggests an English monk named Eilmer of Malmesbury beat him to it by 600 years. He saw the comet in 989 and 1066 and connected the dots.

articles.title: Cracking Nature's Code: The Missing Enzymes Behind a Rare Cancer-Fighting Compound
articles.summary: Mitraphylline, a rare plant compound with anti-cancer potential, has been nearly impossible to produce because its biosynthetic pathway was unknown. Now, researchers have identified the two crucial enzymes that build it, opening a green chemistry route to this and similar life-saving molecules.
